title.original: CurateEvo: Data-Curation Evolving for Agentic Post-Training
title.zh: CurateEvo：面向智能体后训练的演进式数据筛选
title.en: CurateEvo: Data-Curation Evolving for Agentic Post-Training

inclusion_reason.zh: CurateEvo 提供由失败反馈驱动、可自动重写并输出 SFT/RL/记忆数据的筛选闭环，属于可复用后训练数据系统。
inclusion_reason.en: CurateEvo provides a failure-driven curation loop that rewrites itself and emits SFT, RL, and memory data, making it a reusable post-training data system.

abstract.zh: CurateEvo 把智能体后训练的数据筛选策略表示为可执行代码，并利用开发集失败轨迹持续重写策略，使同一原始语料动态产出 SFT、RL 与推理记忆数据。
abstract.en: CurateEvo represents agent post-training curation as executable code and repeatedly rewrites it from development-set failures, turning one raw corpus into evolving SFT, RL, and inference-memory data.

problem.zh: 固定的一次性数据筛选无法响应长时程智能体在环境中的新失败，既可能遗漏有效轨迹，也会保留大量冗余训练轮次。
problem.en: One-shot curation cannot react to new long-horizon agent failures, causing useful trajectories to be missed and redundant training turns to accumulate.

approach.zh: 每轮先诊断保留开发集中的失败模式，再让策略代码执行增补、过滤和改写；效果稳定后，以成本目标剪除低效训练轮次。
approach.en: Each round diagnoses held-out failure patterns and rewrites curation code to augment, filter, or refine data; after improving effectiveness, a cost objective prunes low-utility training turns.

system_design.zh: 闭环由固定原始语料、失败轨迹分析器、策略代码演化器、三类数据产物以及后训练评估反馈组成，下一轮依据反馈更新筛选程序。
system_design.en: The loop connects a fixed raw corpus, failure-trajectory analyzer, curation-code evolver, three output stores, and post-training evaluation feedback that drives the next policy revision.

key_results.zh: 在工具使用与对话智能体基准的有标签和野生数据设置中，动态筛选稳定优于既有方法，并减少数据处理开销。
key_results.en: Across labeled and wild-data settings on tool-use and conversational-agent benchmarks, dynamic curation consistently beats prior methods while reducing curation overhead.

limitations.zh: 方法依赖有代表性的开发失败和可靠评估信号；自动改写的代码可能不稳定或过拟合基准，迁移到真实生产流量仍需持续人工审计。
limitations.en: The method depends on representative held-out failures and reliable evaluators; generated curation code may be unstable or overfit benchmarks, and production transfer still requires human audit.
